firstScreen.notes: 1440-first.jpg: 5-word h1 with trade + place, signature chart dominant, big 64F dew point readout fills the old gap, phone in header and hero, Sample rating, story band peeks ~40px; two equally loud filled teal buttons (Call, Book with this reading) (-0.5). 390-first.jpg: h1 2 lines, both actions above fold, sticky bar.

distinctiveness.notes: Comfort Chart Dot in hero (1440-first.jpg), story reading charts (1440-scroll-25.jpg), service icons (1440-scroll-50.jpg), reviews chart (1440-scroll-75.jpg), ZIP reticle, form reading chip and footer badge (1440-full.jpg); it is the tool output and the evidence, not decoration. hvac/A shares nothing. #area and #prices lack the signature.

type.notes: 1440-first.jpg: heavy Chivo h1 scale moment vs small mono readings; DM Mono is the declared accent and now limited to readings/prices/Sample chips (1440-scroll-75.jpg); en-dash ranges and tabular prices (1440-full.jpg #prices). Lead and sub sit at nearly the same size (minor).

layout.notes: 1440-full.jpg: paper/deep/paper/deep/tan/deep/paper/green/paper/deep rhythm with no same-tone neighbours; story frame now used edge to edge (1440-scroll-25.jpg); break re-cut to ~320px drawn band (1440-scroll-50.jpg). #contact left column leaves ~300px void and #sorter floats as a narrow centred column (1440-full.jpg) (-0.5).

photo.notes: Placeholder stock per run note; drawn treatments judged: story slots are drawn 24h reading charts, wet teal + red chip out of band, dry mint + green chip in band (1440-scroll-25.jpg); frost-on-coil break illustrates the headline (1440-scroll-50.jpg); one palette, one stroke. No photograph or video anywhere (1440-full.jpg, 390-full.jpg) keeps it under 9.

copy.notes: Trade-true lines ('72 on the wall, 64 in the air', 'A dehumidifier on the return', 'Ice on the coil...' 1440-scroll-25.jpg, 1440-scroll-50.jpg); one Book verb family; Sample labels on rating, readings, reviews, prices, licence (1440-scroll-75.jpg, 1440-full.jpg); no em dashes; sorter repeat fixed.

mobile.notes: 390-first.jpg composed, both actions above fold, sticky Call/Book bar; render.json no overflow at 320/390; 390-full.jpg stacks story charts and ledger cleanly. Nine full-width ledger buttons are a long thumb scroll (should).

a11y.notes: 1440-rm-full.jpg and 390-rm-full.jpg show every word and the story final state; chart role=img with title, aria-live status, h1>h2>h3 with no skips, hero img alt='' in aria-hidden figure (dist/index.html); forced-colors present. Verify small mono review meta on #1B2F2C (1440-scroll-75.jpg).

motion.notes: Dials drive hero dot (1440-first.jpg); story dot travels into the band with readout to 51F (1440-scroll-25.jpg vs 1440-rm-full.jpg); hero reading carried into the form chip (1440-full.jpg #contact). #area/#prices identical in 1440-full.jpg and 1440-rm-full.jpg, one shared fade (-0.5).

wow.notes: Visitor plots their house (1440-first.jpg), the chart explains the fix (1440-scroll-25.jpg), and the reading waits at the top of the form with 'change' (1440-full.jpg #contact). Nothing to keep (no saved/printed reading), so not 10.

polish.notes: SVG favicon, apple-touch, OG, HVACBusiness JSON-LD, print + forced-colors, square radius, one stroke weight on chart icons (1440-scroll-50.jpg), designed footer with tabular hours (1440-full.jpg). Invisible placeholder hero img preloaded at high priority (dist/index.html, should).
